capex_guidance.text: CFO Amy Hood guided FY2027 capex to approximately $175 billion. She said the figure reflects an accounting change lengthening useful life of data centers/office buildings from 15 to 25 years starting FY2027, which shifts more data center leases from finance leases (counted in capex) to operating leases (not counted in capex); she stated that outside of this useful-life/lease-classification impact, calendar year 2026 capex investment expectations remain unchanged.
capex_guidance.source: Microsoft Q4 FY2026 earnings call, July 30, 2026 (CFO Amy Hood remarks)
